## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior.

## Mathematical scope

List affected propositions or Lean declarations. State any changed hypotheses or conclusions. For documentation-only changes, say so.

## Validation

Give the commands run and their results. Distinguish byte and metadata checks from fresh Lean compilation and kernel replay. Link new receipts when mathematical source changes.

## Release evidence

Explain any change to a frozen manifest, coverage mapping, source checkpoint or verification record. Preserve the evidence for previously released bytes.
